the proposed network architecture is a feasible option for the deployment of distributed embedded systems for educational applications.
networked embedded systems can be successfully deployed to support distributed educational applications.

(i) the use of embedded systems for networked applications is a viable and promising technology; (ii) the use of networked embedded devices in the educational environment is an interesting option for the development of distributed applications; and (iii) the proposed architecture and the technology used are a good choice to support the deployment of such systems.

the development and deployment of distributed systems in educational environment.
the development of a distributed embedded system for the educational environment, which will be used for a variety of educational purposes.

the development and deployment of distributed embedded systems in a networked environment, with a focus on the use of wireless communication technologies, the use of open source software development tools and the deployment of embedded devices in educational environments.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
networked embedded systems are a very promising technology that is expected to have an impact on the educational environment in a very near future.

the proposed architecture is suitable for the deployment of networked embedded applications in the educational field, as well as for other applications in general, where the networked system has to be distributed, robust and reliable.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed, developed and deployed a distributed embedded system that is able to monitor the temperature of the environment and send the data over the network.

we have designed, implemented and tested a network of distributed embedded devices, which are connected to the Internet through the GSM network and are able to communicate and exchange data with the end user through the Internet, using a standard web browser.

the proposed architecture and the two field application examples are a proof of concept that the proposed network architecture and the embedded technology are suitable for educational purposes and that the technology can be used for the deployment of distributed applications in the field.

a networked embedded system can be implemented with a very small investment, and that the system can be used to teach and demonstrate a number of important concepts related to embedded systems and networked systems.
the proposed architecture and the implementation details are generic enough to be used for other similar distributed applications.
